name: Solar System
hook: One star, eight planets and a cast of moons — the facts Jeopardy keeps asking.

facts.label: an orrery
facts.statement: An orrery is a clockwork model of the solar system, named for the 18th-century Earl of Orrery.

facts.label: Copernicus
facts.statement: The Polish astronomer Copernicus put the Sun at the center of the solar system, and Kepler defended that heliocentric model.

facts.label: Venus
facts.statement: Venus is the hottest planet — its thick atmosphere traps heat in a runaway greenhouse effect — even though it is second from the Sun.

facts.label: Earth
facts.statement: Earth is the densest planet and the only one not named for a deity; it is almost four times denser than the Sun.

facts.label: Mars
facts.statement: Mars has the solar system's tallest volcano, Olympus Mons, and exactly two moons.

facts.label: Jupiter
facts.statement: Jupiter is the largest planet and, after the Sun, the solar system's most massive object; its moon Io is the only other world known to have active volcanoes.

facts.label: Titan
facts.statement: Titan, Saturn's largest moon, is the second-largest moon in the solar system after Ganymede and orbits Saturn in about 16 days.
